rules.text: You have 14 days from the date of purchase or receipt to process a return request.
rules.quote: If you decide that an item isn't the right fit for you, we invite you to visit your  returns page  to process a return request.

rules.text: ThredUp offers three refund options: ThredUp credit, original payment method, or donation to charity.
rules.quote: ThredUp  has three different refund options available: - ThredUp  credit: We'll give you a free return shipping label...

rules.text: If you choose ThredUp credit as your refund option, you receive a free return shipping label.
rules.quote: ThredUp  credit: We'll give you a free return shipping label...

rules.text: Some returns qualify for an instant refund based on factors such as return history.
rules.quote: Some returns qualify for an instant refund based on factors such as return history.

rules.text: If your order doesn’t qualify for an instant refund, you will receive a refund after the return is processed.
rules.quote: If your order doesn’t qualify for an instant refund, you will receive ...

rules.text: Once a return has been processed, the refund method cannot be changed.
rules.quote: Once a return has been processed, the refund method cannot be changed.

rules.text: All returns must be postmarked within 14 days from the date of delivery of an item.
rules.quote: All returns must be postmarked within 14 days from the date of delivery of an item.

rules.text: All items are subject to a $3.99 restocking fee.
rules.quote: All items are subject to a $3.99 restocking fee

rules.text: Original shipping charge is not refunded when returning items.
rules.quote: Original shipping charge is not refunded when returning items

rules.text: Final sale items are not returnable.
rules.quote: Final sale items are not returnable

rules.text: Items purchased with ThredUp store credits will always be refunded back as store credits.
rules.quote: Items purchased with ThredUp store credits will always be refunded back as store credits

rules.text: ThredUp store credits will be refunded back to your account 5-7 days after ThredUp has received your return order.
rules.quote: ThredUp store credits will be refunded back to your account 5-7 days after ThredUp has received your return order

rules.text: Credit card refunds can take an additional 3-5 business days to be refunded after ThredUp has received your return order.
rules.quote: credit card refunds can take an additional 3-5 business days to be refunded.

rules.text: Promotions and discounts will not be reimbursed.
rules.quote: Promotions and discounts will not be reimbursed

rules.text: ThredUp does not offer return shipping labels for orders shipped outside the contiguous 48 United States.
rules.quote: ThredUp does not offer return shipping labels for orders shipped outside the contiguous 48 United States at this time.

rules.text: To qualify for a refund, all items must be in the same condition in which you received them.
rules.quote: To qualify for a refund, all items must be in the same condition in which you received them

rules.text: Refunds will be issued back to your original form of payment for orders shipped internationally or outside the contiguous 48 United States.
rules.quote: Refunds will be issued back to your original form of payment.

rules.text: Returns choosing refund as ThredUp credits may be refunded as soon as scanned into transit or within 3-5 business days upon delivery to warehouse.
rules.quote: For returns that choose ThredUp credits, the return _may be_ refunded as soon as it is scanned into transit by the carrier. If not, then it will be refunded within 3-5 business days upon delivery to our warehouse.
